---- MODULE W4Od18m8p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A smart-home door lock network permanently commissions door locks under a     *)
(* hierarchical locking discipline: an installer agent must hold the coarse       *)
(* network lock and then a door's fine lock before commissioning it.  Locking in  *)
(* a door's master key is irreversible and must happen at most once per door.     *)
(* One agent may crash silently, dropping any locks it held.                      *)

Agents == {"ag1", "ag2"}
Doors  == {"front", "back"}
Free   == "free"

VARIABLES coarse, fine, commissioned, crashed

vars == << coarse, fine, commissioned, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Agents \cup {Free}
    /\ fine \in [Doors -> Agents \cup {Free}]
    /\ commissioned \in [Doors -> Nat]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Agents

Init ==
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ fine = [d \in Doors |-> Free]
    /\ commissioned = [d \in Doors |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireCoarse(a) ==
    /\ a \notin crashed
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ coarse' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, commissioned, crashed >>

AcquireFine(a, d) ==
    /\ coarse = a
    /\ fine[d] = Free
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![d] = a]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, commissioned, crashed >>

\* Irreversibly commission a door; requires both locks and door not yet done.
Commission(a, d) ==
    /\ coarse = a
    /\ fine[d] = a
    /\ commissioned[d] = 0
    /\ commissioned' = [commissioned EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, fine, crashed >>

ReleaseFine(a, d) ==
    /\ fine[d] = a
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![d] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED << coarse, commissioned, crashed >>

ReleaseCoarse(a) ==
    /\ coarse = a
    /\ coarse' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED << fine, commissioned, crashed >>

\* One agent crashes silently, dropping every lock it held.
Crash(a) ==
    /\ a \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {a}
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = a THEN Free ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = [d \in Doors |-> IF fine[d] = a THEN Free ELSE fine[d]]
    /\ UNCHANGED commissioned

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents : AcquireCoarse(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, d \in Doors : AcquireFine(a, d)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, d \in Doors : Commission(a, d)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, d \in Doors : ReleaseFine(a, d)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : ReleaseCoarse(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Crash(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The irreversible commissioning happens at most once per door.                *)
CommissionAtMostOnce == \A d \in Doors : commissioned[d] <= 1
====
nl:
A smart-home door lock network permanently commissions door locks ("front",
"back") using a hierarchical locking discipline. Two installer agents ("ag1",
"ag2") coordinate: an agent must first hold the coarse network lock, then acquire
a door's fine lock, and only while holding both may it commission that door.
Commissioning — locking in a door's master key — is an irreversible action that
must happen at most once per door. One agent may crash silently, dropping any
locks it was holding.

The system takes these steps. AcquireCoarse(a): a live agent takes the free
coarse network lock. AcquireFine(a,d): an agent holding the coarse lock takes a
door's free fine lock. Commission(a,d): an agent holding both the coarse lock and
door d's fine lock irreversibly commissions door d, provided it has not been
commissioned before. ReleaseFine(a,d): a door's fine lock holder releases it.
ReleaseCoarse(a): the coarse lock holder releases it. Crash(a): one agent crashes
silently, dropping every lock it held.

Because commissioning is guarded by the door not already being commissioned and
requires both locks in the hierarchy, no door's master key can be locked in a
second time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every door is commissioned at most once, so the irreversible
commissioning action happens at most once per door.

---- MODULE W4Od3m5p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A bank's interbank settlement batch admits transactions into a bounded window *)
(* of in-flight settlements.  A transaction is admitted by quorum voting: a       *)
(* quorum of member banks must vote for it.  A privileged admin override may      *)
(* admit a transaction without a quorum.  Either way, admission is allowed only   *)
(* while the in-flight window is below its fixed capacity, so the bounded          *)
(* capacity is never exceeded.                                                    *)

CONSTANTS Quorum, Cap

Txns   == {"tx1", "tx2"}
Voters == {"ba", "bb"}

VARIABLES state, votes, acks, adminUsed

vars == << state, votes, acks, adminUsed >>

InFlight == {t \in Txns : state[t] = "admitted"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ state \in [Txns -> {"new", "admitted", "settled"}]
    /\ votes \in [Txns -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ acks \in [Txns -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ adminUsed \subseteq Txns

Init ==
    /\ state = [t \in Txns |-> "new"]
    /\ votes = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ acks = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ adminUsed = {}

Vote(v, t) ==
    /\ state[t] = "new"
    /\ v \notin votes[t]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << state, acks, adminUsed >>

\* Admit by quorum, only while the in-flight window has room.
Admit(t) ==
    /\ state[t] = "new"
    /\ Cardinality(votes[t]) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(InFlight) < Cap
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![t] = "admitted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks, adminUsed >>

\* Privileged admin override: admit without a quorum, still under capacity.
AdminAdmit(t) ==
    /\ state[t] = "new"
    /\ Cardinality(InFlight) < Cap
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![t] = "admitted"]
    /\ adminUsed' = adminUsed \cup {t}
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks >>

Ack(v, t) ==
    /\ state[t] = "admitted"
    /\ v \notin acks[t]
    /\ acks' = [acks EXCEPT ![t] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << state, votes, adminUsed >>

Settle(t) ==
    /\ state[t] = "admitted"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![t] = "settled"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks, adminUsed >>

Reset ==
    /\ \A t \in Txns : state[t] = "settled"
    /\ state' = [t \in Txns |-> "new"]
    /\ votes' = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ acks' = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
    /\ adminUsed' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Voters, t \in Txns : Vote(v, t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Admit(t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : AdminAdmit(t)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, t \in Txns : Ack(v, t)
    \/ \E t \in Txns : Settle(t)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The in-flight settlement window never exceeds its fixed capacity.            *)
WithinCapacity == Cardinality(InFlight) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS Quorum = 2
          Cap = 1
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch admits transactions ("tx1", "tx2") into a
bounded window of in-flight settlements. Admission uses quorum voting on each
action: a quorum of member banks ("ba", "bb") must vote for a transaction before
it can be admitted. There is a privileged admin override: an administrator may
admit a transaction without a quorum. In either case, admission is permitted only
while the number of in-flight settlements is below a fixed capacity, so the
bounded capacity is never exceeded.

The system takes these steps. Vote(v,t): a member bank casts a vote for a new
transaction. Admit(t): a new transaction with at least a quorum of votes is
admitted, but only while the in-flight window is below capacity. AdminAdmit(t):
the privileged admin override admits a new transaction without a quorum, still
only while below capacity. Ack(v,t): a member bank acknowledges an admitted
transaction. Settle(t): an admitted transaction is settled and leaves the
in-flight window. Reset: once every transaction is settled, a new batch resets
the system.

Because both the quorum-admit and admin-override paths are guarded by the
in-flight count being strictly below the fixed capacity and each admission adds
exactly one in-flight transaction, the in-flight window can never exceed the
capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of in-flight settlements is always less than or equal
to the fixed capacity, so the bounded capacity is never exceeded.

---- MODULE W4Od14m0p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shifts a fixed stock of retardant between  *)
(* a depot and the drones' aggregate tanks using optimistic locking with retry.   *)
(* A transfer commits only if the depot's version snapshot is still current,       *)
(* which then bumps the version so a stale attempt must re-snapshot and retry.     *)
(* The per-fleet holding capacity changes at runtime.  Stock is conserved.         *)

CONSTANTS Total, MaxV

VARIABLES depot, held, ver, snap, capacity

vars == << depot, held, ver, snap, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ depot \in 0..Total
    /\ held \in 0..Total
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxV
    /\ snap \in 0..MaxV
    /\ capacity \in 1..Total

Init ==
    /\ depot = Total
    /\ held = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ snap = 0
    /\ capacity = Total

\* Snapshot the depot's optimistic version to attempt a transfer.
Prepare ==
    /\ snap' = ver
    /\ UNCHANGED << depot, held, ver, capacity >>

\* Commit a depot -> fleet transfer only if the snapshot still matches.
Load ==
    /\ snap = ver
    /\ depot > 0
    /\ held < capacity
    /\ depot' = depot - 1
    /\ held' = held + 1
    /\ ver' = IF ver < MaxV THEN ver + 1 ELSE ver
    /\ UNCHANGED << snap, capacity >>

\* Return a unit from the fleet to the depot.
Unload ==
    /\ held > 0
    /\ held' = held - 1
    /\ depot' = depot + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, snap, capacity >>

\* A concurrent write bumps the depot version, invalidating a stale snapshot.
Bump ==
    /\ ver < MaxV
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << depot, held, snap, capacity >>

\* The per-fleet holding capacity is re-provisioned at runtime.
Resize(k) ==
    /\ k # capacity
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED << depot, held, ver, snap >>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Load
    \/ Unload
    \/ Bump
    \/ \E k \in 1..Total : Resize(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* Retardant is conserved: the depot plus the fleet's aggregate holding always   *)
(* equals the fixed total stock -- nothing is created or destroyed.              *)
Conservation == depot + held = Total
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS Total = 3
          MaxV = 2
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shifts a fixed stock of fire-retardant units
between a central depot and the drones' aggregate fleet tanks using optimistic
locking with retry. A transfer from the depot to the fleet commits only if the
dispatcher's snapshot of the depot's version register still matches the live
version; a successful commit bumps the version, so a concurrent attempt holding a
stale snapshot must re-snapshot and retry. The per-fleet holding capacity changes
at runtime. The total retardant is conserved.

The system takes these steps. Prepare: the dispatcher snapshots the depot's
current version to attempt a transfer. Load: a depot-to-fleet transfer of one
unit commits only if the snapshot still matches the live version and the fleet is
below its holding capacity; this bumps the version. Unload: one unit is returned
from the fleet to the depot. Bump: a concurrent write increments the depot
version, invalidating any outstanding snapshot. Resize(k): the fleet holding
capacity is changed to a new value k at runtime.

Because every load moves one unit from the depot to the fleet and every unload
moves one unit back, while snapshots, version bumps, and resizes touch no counts,
the total number of retardant units never changes.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the depot stock plus the fleet's aggregate holding always equals
the fixed total, so no retardant unit is ever created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od17m5p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* An airport baggage router commits routing-table updates by quorum voting on   *)
(* each action: a quorum of controllers must vote before the next update is        *)
(* committed.  A committed update may then be acknowledged to its requester, and   *)
(* only committed updates are ever acknowledged, so no acknowledged update is      *)
(* lost.  The committed-window capacity changes at runtime.                        *)

CONSTANTS Quorum, MaxId

Voters == {"c1", "c2"}

VARIABLES nextId, votes, committed, acked, capacity

vars == << nextId, votes, committed, acked, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ nextId \in 1..(MaxId + 1)
    /\ votes \subseteq Voters
    /\ committed \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ acked \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxId

Init ==
    /\ nextId = 1
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ capacity = MaxId

\* Vote for the current pending update (identified by nextId).
Vote(v) ==
    /\ nextId <= MaxId
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED << nextId, committed, acked, capacity >>

\* Commit the pending update once a quorum has voted and there is room.
Commit ==
    /\ nextId <= MaxId
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ Cardinality(committed) < capacity
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {nextId}
    /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED << acked, capacity >>

\* Acknowledge a committed update back to its requester.
Ack(id) ==
    /\ id \in committed
    /\ id \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED << nextId, votes, committed, capacity >>

\* Re-provision the committed-window capacity at runtime.
Resize(k) ==
    /\ k # capacity
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED << nextId, votes, committed, acked >>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ \E id \in 1..MaxId : Ack(id)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxId : Resize(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No acknowledged update is ever lost: every acknowledged id is present in the *)
(* committed routing record.                                                    *)
NoLostUpdate == acked \subseteq committed
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS Quorum = 2
          MaxId = 4
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
An airport baggage router commits updates to its shared routing table using
quorum voting on each action. Updates are numbered consecutively. Two controllers
("c1", "c2") vote for the current pending update, and only once a quorum has
voted is that update committed into the routing record. A committed update may
then be acknowledged back to the requester that submitted it, and only
already-committed updates are ever acknowledged, so no acknowledged update is
lost. The committed-window capacity changes at runtime.

The system takes these steps. Vote(v): a controller casts its vote for the
current pending update. Commit: once a quorum has voted and the committed window
is below its capacity, the pending update is committed and voting resets for the
next update. Ack(id): an update that has been committed is acknowledged to its
requester. Resize(k): the committed-window capacity is changed to a new value k
at runtime.

Because acknowledgement is only ever issued for an already-committed update, and
committing adds the update to the routing record, every acknowledged update
remains present in the record.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged update is present in the committed routing
record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od2m3p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A warehouse robot fleet moves a fixed number of packages between the shelf    *)
(* and the floor.  Two fleet instances share one package pool and coordinate by   *)
(* leader election with failover; only the current leader may move a package.     *)
(* Packages are neither created nor destroyed: shelf plus floor always equals     *)
(* the fixed total.                                                               *)

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch, Total

Instances == {"fleetA", "fleetB"}
NoLeader  == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, shelf, onFloor

vars == << leader, epoch, shelf, onFloor >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Instances \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ shelf \in 0..Total
    /\ onFloor \in 0..Total

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ shelf = Total
    /\ onFloor = 0

Elect(i) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ leader' = i
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED << shelf, onFloor >>

Failover(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ leader' = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, shelf, onFloor >>

\* The leader moves one package shelf -> floor.
Pick(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ onFloor' = onFloor + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, epoch >>

\* The leader moves one package floor -> shelf.
Stow(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ onFloor > 0
    /\ onFloor' = onFloor - 1
    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Elect(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Failover(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Pick(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Stow(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* Packages are conserved: shelf plus floor always equals the fixed total.      *)
Conservation == shelf + onFloor = Total
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxEpoch = 3
          Total = 3
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet moves a fixed number of packages between the shelf and
the floor. Two independent fleet instances ("fleetA", "fleetB") share one package
pool and coordinate by leader election with failover: at most one instance is the
leader at a time, and each election bumps a leadership epoch. Only the current
leader may move a package. Packages are neither created nor destroyed.

The system takes these steps. Elect(i): when there is no leader, an instance
becomes leader and the epoch advances. Failover(i): the current leader steps
down, leaving no leader until the next election. Pick(i): the leader moves one
package from the shelf to the floor. Stow(i): the leader moves one package from
the floor to the shelf.

Because every pick and stow moves exactly one package between the shelf and the
floor and leadership changes touch no counts, the total number of packages never
changes.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of packages on the shelf plus the number on the floor
always equals the fixed total, so no package is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m6p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A library book reservation system caps the number of simultaneously active    *)
(* reservations.  Two instances share one reservation pool and serialise changes  *)
(* through a single lease with expiry: only the holder of an unexpired lease may   *)
(* add or cancel a reservation, and a reservation is added only while the active   *)
(* count is below the fixed capacity, so the capacity is never exceeded.           *)

CONSTANTS MaxT, TTL, Cap, MaxSlots

Instances == {"libA", "libB"}
NoOne     == "none"

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, reserved

vars == << clock, holder, expiry, reserved >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ holder \in Instances \cup {NoOne}
    /\ expiry \in 0..MaxT
    /\ reserved \in 0..MaxSlots

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ reserved = 0

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, expiry, reserved >>

Acquire(i) ==
    /\ (holder = NoOne \/ clock >= expiry)
    /\ holder' = i
    /\ expiry' = IF clock + TTL <= MaxT THEN clock + TTL ELSE MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, reserved >>

Release(i) ==
    /\ holder = i
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, expiry, reserved >>

\* Add a reservation; requires a valid lease and room under the capacity.
Reserve(i) ==
    /\ holder = i
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ reserved < Cap
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, holder, expiry >>

\* Cancel a reservation; requires a valid lease.
Cancel(i) ==
    /\ holder = i
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, holder, expiry >>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Acquire(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reserve(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Cancel(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The number of active reservations never exceeds the fixed capacity.          *)
WithinCapacity == reserved <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxT = 3
          TTL = 2
          Cap = 2
          MaxSlots = 4
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A library book reservation system caps the number of simultaneously active
reservations at a fixed capacity. Two independent instances ("libA", "libB")
share one reservation pool and serialise changes through a single lease with
expiry: an instance must hold an unexpired lease to modify the pool, and leases
lapse as a global clock advances. Only the lease holder may add or cancel a
reservation, and a reservation is added only while the active count is below the
capacity, so the capacity is never exceeded.

The system takes these steps. Tick: the global clock advances by one, possibly
expiring the lease. Acquire(i): an instance takes the lease when it is free or
expired, receiving a fresh expiry. Release(i): the lease holder releases the
lease. Reserve(i): the holder of a valid lease adds one reservation, but only
while the active count is below the capacity. Cancel(i): the holder of a valid
lease cancels one reservation.

Because adding a reservation is guarded by the active count being strictly below
the fixed capacity and each add increases the count by one, the number of active
reservations can never exceed the capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of active reservations is always less than or equal
to the fixed capacity, so the bounded capacity is never exceeded.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m0p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

(* A pharmacy prescription dispenser fills scripts under optimistic locking with  *)
(* retry.  Filling a script is irreversible and must happen at most once.  A       *)
(* dispenser snapshots a global version, and its fill commits only if the          *)
(* snapshot is still current, which bumps the version so a stale attempt must      *)
(* abort and retry.  One dispenser may crash silently.  Every fill is appended to  *)
(* an audit log that must never name the same script twice.                        *)

CONSTANT MaxV

Scripts    == {"rx1", "rx2"}
Dispensers == {"d1", "d2"}
NoSnap     == MaxV + 1

VARIABLES gver, dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed

vars == << gver, dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ gver \in 0..MaxV
    /\ dispensed \subseteq Scripts
    /\ auditLog \in Seq(Scripts)
    /\ snap \in [Dispensers -> 0..(MaxV + 1)]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Dispensers

Init ==
    /\ gver = 0
    /\ dispensed = {}
    /\ auditLog = << >>
    /\ snap = [d \in Dispensers |-> NoSnap]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Snapshot the current global version (no outstanding attempt).
Prepare(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ snap[d] = NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = gver]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog, crashed >>

Bump ==
    /\ gver < MaxV
    /\ gver' = gver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << dispensed, auditLog, snap, crashed >>

\* Commit the irreversible fill only if the optimistic snapshot still holds.
Commit(d, s) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[d] = gver
    /\ s \notin dispensed
    /\ dispensed' = dispensed \cup {s}
    /\ auditLog' = Append(auditLog, s)
    /\ gver' = IF gver < MaxV THEN gver + 1 ELSE gver
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

Abort(d) ==
    /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog, crashed >>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ d \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED << gver, dispensed, auditLog >>

Reset ==
    /\ \A s \in Scripts : s \in dispensed
    /\ gver' = 0
    /\ dispensed' = {}
    /\ auditLog' = << >>
    /\ snap' = [d \in Dispensers |-> NoSnap]
    /\ crashed' = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Prepare(d)
    \/ Bump
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers, s \in Scripts : Commit(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Abort(d)
    \/ \E d \in Dispensers : Crash(d)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The irreversible fill happens at most once per script: no script is ever      *)
(* named twice in the audit log.                                                 *)
FillAtMostOnce ==
    \A a, b \in 1..Len(auditLog) : (auditLog[a] = auditLog[b]) => (a = b)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANT MaxV = 2
INVARIANT FillAtMostOnce
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser fills scripts ("rx1", "rx2") under optimistic
locking with retry. Filling a script is an irreversible action that must happen
at most once per script. Two dispensers ("d1", "d2") coordinate: a dispenser
snapshots a global version register, and its fill commits only if the snapshot is
still current at commit time. A successful commit bumps the version, so any other
dispenser still holding a stale snapshot must abort and retry. One dispenser may
crash silently, dropping its outstanding snapshot. Every fill is appended to an
audit log that must never name the same script twice.

The system takes these steps. Prepare(d): a live dispenser with no outstanding
attempt snapshots the current global version. Bump: a concurrent write increments
the global version, invalidating outstanding snapshots. Commit(d,s): a dispenser
fills a not-yet-filled script only if its snapshot still matches the live version;
this appends the script to the audit log and bumps the version. Abort(d): a
dispenser abandons its attempt (stale snapshot or plain retry). Crash(d): one
dispenser crashes silently, dropping its snapshot. Reset: once every script has
been filled, a new batch resets the state.

Because a commit requires an unchanged snapshot and is guarded by the script not
already being filled, and every commit bumps the version, no script's fill can be
committed a second time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no script is ever named more than once in the fill audit log, so
the irreversible fill action happens at most once per script.

---- MODULE W4Od16m2p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs dispensing operations through two-phase *)
(* commit and caps how many may be active at once.  Each operation is proposed     *)
(* (consuming a request that may arrive in any order), voted on by participants,   *)
(* and committed to the active set only while the active count is below the fixed  *)
(* capacity.  The active set never exceeds the capacity.                           *)

CONSTANT Cap

Ops    == {"op1", "op2"}
Parts  == {"pa", "pb"}
Reqs   == {1, 2}

VARIABLES state, votes, acks, pending

vars == << state, votes, acks, pending >>

Active == {o \in Ops : state[o] = "active"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ state \in [Ops -> {"new", "voting", "active", "done"}]
    /\ votes \in [Ops -> SUBSET Parts]
    /\ acks \in [Ops -> SUBSET Parts]
    /\ pending \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
    /\ state = [o \in Ops |-> "new"]
    /\ votes = [o \in Ops |-> {}]
    /\ acks = [o \in Ops |-> {}]
    /\ pending = Reqs

\* Propose an operation, consuming any pending request (arbitrary order).
Propose(o, r) ==
    /\ state[o] = "new"
    /\ r \in pending
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "voting"]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks >>

Vote(p, o) ==
    /\ state[o] = "voting"
    /\ p \notin votes[o]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![o] = @ \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << state, acks, pending >>

\* Commit only on a unanimous vote and while the active set has room.
Commit(o) ==
    /\ state[o] = "voting"
    /\ votes[o] = Parts
    /\ Cardinality(Active) < Cap
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "active"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks, pending >>

Ack(p, o) ==
    /\ state[o] = "active"
    /\ p \notin acks[o]
    /\ acks' = [acks EXCEPT ![o] = @ \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << state, votes, pending >>

Finish(o) ==
    /\ state[o] = "active"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, acks, pending >>

Reset ==
    /\ \A o \in Ops : state[o] = "done"
    /\ state' = [o \in Ops |-> "new"]
    /\ votes' = [o \in Ops |-> {}]
    /\ acks' = [o \in Ops |-> {}]
    /\ pending' = Reqs

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Ops, r \in Reqs : Propose(o, r)
    \/ \E p \in Parts, o \in Ops : Vote(p, o)
    \/ \E o \in Ops : Commit(o)
    \/ \E p \in Parts, o \in Ops : Ack(p, o)
    \/ \E o \in Ops : Finish(o)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The number of active dispensing operations never exceeds the fixed capacity. *)
WithinCapacity == Cardinality(Active) <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANT Cap = 1
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs dispensing operations ("op1", "op2")
through two-phase commit across participants ("pa", "pb") and caps how many
operations may be active at once at a fixed capacity. An operation is first
proposed — consuming a dispensing request that may arrive in any order (messages
can be reordered) — then voted on by the participants, and committed to the
active set only while the number of active operations is below the capacity. The
active set never exceeds the capacity.

The system takes these steps. Propose(o,r): a new operation enters the voting
phase, consuming any pending request chosen in arbitrary order. Vote(p,o): a
participant casts its vote for an operation in the voting phase. Commit(o): once
all participants have voted and the active set is below capacity, the operation
becomes active. Ack(p,o): a participant acknowledges an active operation.
Finish(o): an active operation completes and leaves the active set. Reset: once
every operation is done, a new batch resets the system.

Because commitment to the active set is guarded by the active count being
strictly below the fixed capacity and each commit adds exactly one active
operation, the active set can never exceed the capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of active dispensing operations is always less than
or equal to the fixed capacity, so the bounded capacity is never exceeded.

---- MODULE W4Od4m6p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

(* A car-wash conveyor line applies a final wax seal to cars.  Sealing a car is  *)
(* an irreversible action that must happen at most once per car.  A single lease  *)
(* with expiry serialises the seal head: only the holder of an unexpired lease may *)
(* seal, and a car leaves the wait pool the moment it is sealed.  Cars may be      *)
(* pulled from the pool in any order (messages reordered).                         *)

CONSTANTS MaxT, TTL

Cars == {"car1", "car2"}
Ops  == {"o1", "o2"}
NoOne == "none"

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, sealLog, pool

vars == << clock, holder, expiry, sealLog, pool >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ holder \in Ops \cup {NoOne}
    /\ expiry \in 0..MaxT
    /\ sealLog \in Seq(Cars)
    /\ pool \subseteq Cars

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ sealLog = << >>
    /\ pool = Cars

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, expiry, sealLog, pool >>

Acquire(o) ==
    /\ (holder = NoOne \/ clock >= expiry)
    /\ holder' = o
    /\ expiry' = IF clock + TTL <= MaxT THEN clock + TTL ELSE MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, sealLog, pool >>

Release(o) ==
    /\ holder = o
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, expiry, sealLog, pool >>

\* Irreversibly seal any car still in the pool; requires a valid lease.
Seal(o, car) ==
    /\ holder = o
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ car \in pool
    /\ sealLog' = Append(sealLog, car)
    /\ pool' = pool \ {car}
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, holder, expiry >>

Reset ==
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ clock' = 0
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ expiry' = 0
    /\ sealLog' = << >>
    /\ pool' = Cars

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E o \in Ops : Acquire(o)
    \/ \E o \in Ops : Release(o)
    \/ \E o \in Ops, car \in Cars : Seal(o, car)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* The irreversible seal happens at most once per car: no car is ever named      *)
(* twice in the seal audit log.                                                  *)
SealAtMostOnce ==
    \A a, b \in 1..Len(sealLog) : (sealLog[a] = sealLog[b]) => (a = b)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxT = 3
          TTL = 2
INVARIANT SealAtMostOnce
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line applies a final wax seal to cars ("car1", "car2").
Sealing a car is an irreversible action that must happen at most once per car.
Two operators ("o1", "o2") contend for a single lease with expiry on the seal
head: an operator must hold an unexpired lease to seal, and leases lapse as a
global clock advances. A car leaves the wait pool the moment it is sealed, and
cars may be pulled from the pool in any order — messages can be reordered. Every
seal is appended to an audit log that must never name the same car twice.

The system takes these steps. Tick: the global clock advances by one, possibly
expiring the lease. Acquire(o): an operator takes the lease when it is free or
expired, receiving a fresh expiry. Release(o): the lease holder releases the
lease. Seal(o,car): the holder of a valid lease irreversibly seals any car still
in the pool, chosen in arbitrary order, appending it to the audit log and
removing it from the pool. Reset: once the pool is empty, a new conveyor cycle
refills it.

Because a car leaves the pool the moment it is sealed and only in-pool cars can
be sealed, no car is ever sealed or logged a second time.

SAFETY PROPERTY: no car is ever named more than once in the seal audit log, so
the irreversible seal action happens at most once per car.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

(* A bank's interbank settlement batch applies updates through a single elected  *)
(* leader with failover.  Only the current leader applies updates to the durable  *)
(* record, advancing the applied count.  An update is acknowledged only after it   *)
(* is applied, so the acknowledged position never runs ahead of the applied        *)
(* record -- no acknowledged update is lost.  One instance may crash silently.     *)

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch, MaxUpd

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
NoLeader  == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, applied, ackedUpto, crashed

vars == << leader, epoch, applied, ackedUpto, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Instances \cup {NoLeader}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ applied \in 0..MaxUpd
    /\ ackedUpto \in 0..MaxUpd
    /\ crashed \subseteq Instances

Init ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ applied = 0
    /\ ackedUpto = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Elect(i) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ i \notin crashed
    /\ leader' = i
    /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
    /\ UNCHANGED << applied, ackedUpto, crashed >>

Failover(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ leader' = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, applied, ackedUpto, crashed >>

\* Only the leader applies an update to the durable record.
Apply(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ applied < MaxUpd
    /\ applied' = applied + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, epoch, ackedUpto, crashed >>

\* Acknowledge the next update, but only once it has been applied.
Ack ==
    /\ ackedUpto < applied
    /\ ackedUpto' = ackedUpto + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, epoch, applied, crashed >>

\* One instance crashes silently; a crashed leader steps down.
Crash(i) ==
    /\ i \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {i}
    /\ leader' = IF leader = i THEN NoLeader ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, applied, ackedUpto >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Elect(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Failover(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Apply(i)
    \/ Ack
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Crash(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No acknowledged update is lost: the acknowledged position never runs ahead   *)
(* of the applied record.                                                        *)
NoLostUpdate == ackedUpto <= applied
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxEpoch = 3
          MaxUpd = 4
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch applies updates through a single elected
leader with failover. Two instances ("i1", "i2") contend for leadership: at most
one is leader at a time, and each election bumps a leadership epoch. Only the
current leader applies updates to the durable settlement record, advancing the
applied count. An update is acknowledged to clients only after it has been
applied, so the acknowledged position never runs ahead of the applied record and
no acknowledged update is lost. One instance may crash silently.

The system takes these steps. Elect(i): when there is no leader, a live instance
becomes leader and the epoch advances. Failover(i): the current leader steps
down, leaving no leader until the next election. Apply(i): the leader applies the
next update to the durable record, advancing the applied count. Ack: the
acknowledged position advances by one, but only while it is still behind the
applied count. Crash(i): one instance crashes silently, and a crashed leader
steps down.

Because acknowledgement can only advance while it is strictly behind the applied
count, the acknowledged position can never exceed the number of applied updates.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the acknowledged position is always less than or equal to the
applied count of the durable record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od18m9p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

(* A smart-home door lock network applies policy updates to a shared record and   *)
(* runs epoch-numbered reconfiguration.  An admitted update is first pending       *)
(* (a slow node may take arbitrarily long to apply it, but never drops it), then   *)
(* committed to the record, and only a committed update may be acknowledged.  So    *)
(* every acknowledged update sits in the committed record -- none is lost.          *)

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch, MaxId

VARIABLES epoch, committed, acked, pending, nextId

vars == << epoch, committed, acked, pending, nextId >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ committed \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ acked \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ pending \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ nextId \in 1..(MaxId + 1)

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ nextId = 1

\* Admit the next policy update; it becomes pending.
Admit ==
    /\ nextId <= MaxId
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {nextId}
    /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, committed, acked >>

\* A reconfiguration advances the epoch; slow pending updates are untouched.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << committed, acked, pending, nextId >>

\* Commit a pending update to the record (a slow node applies it eventually).
Commit(id) ==
    /\ id \in pending
    /\ pending' = pending \ {id}
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, acked, nextId >>

\* Acknowledge a committed update back to its requester.
Ack(id) ==
    /\ id \in committed
    /\ id \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, committed, pending, nextId >>

Reset ==
    /\ nextId > MaxId
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ epoch' = 0
    /\ committed' = {}
    /\ acked' = {}
    /\ pending' = {}
    /\ nextId' = 1

Next ==
    \/ Admit
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E id \in 1..MaxId : Commit(id)
    \/ \E id \in 1..MaxId : Ack(id)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No acknowledged update is lost: every acknowledged id is present in the       *)
(* committed policy record.                                                      *)
NoLostUpdate == acked \subseteq committed
====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxEpoch = 2
          MaxId = 4
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door lock network applies policy updates to a shared policy record
and runs epoch-numbered reconfiguration. Updates are numbered consecutively. An
admitted update first becomes pending: a slow node may take arbitrarily long to
apply it, but it is never dropped. A pending update is then committed to the
record, and only a committed update may be acknowledged back to its requester.
Because acknowledgement follows commitment, every acknowledged update sits in the
committed record and none is lost. Nodes may be slow but never fail.

The system takes these steps. Admit: the next consecutive policy update is
admitted and becomes pending. Reconfigure: the network advances its epoch,
leaving slow pending updates untouched. Commit(id): a pending update is applied to
the committed record (a slow node applies it eventually). Ack(id): a committed
update is acknowledged to its requester. Reset: once every update has been
admitted and no update is left pending, a fresh cycle resets the system.

Because an update is acknowledged only after it has been committed, every
acknowledged update remains present in the committed record.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged update is present in the committed policy
record, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od7m9p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

(* A container-ship crane yard records crane moves in a durable append-only log   *)
(* and runs epoch-numbered reconfiguration.  Pending moves may be committed in     *)
(* any order (messages reordered); committing appends the move to the durable log. *)
(* A move is acknowledged only once it appears in the durable log, so every        *)
(* acknowledged move is logged -- none is lost.                                    *)

CONSTANTS MaxEpoch, MaxId

VARIABLES moveLog, acked, epoch, pending, nextId

vars == << moveLog, acked, epoch, pending, nextId >>

Logged == {moveLog[k] : k \in 1..Len(moveLog)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ moveLog \in Seq(1..MaxId)
    /\ acked \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ pending \subseteq (1..MaxId)
    /\ nextId \in 1..(MaxId + 1)

Init ==
    /\ moveLog = << >>
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ nextId = 1

\* Admit the next crane move; it becomes pending.
Admit ==
    /\ nextId <= MaxId
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {nextId}
    /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << moveLog, acked, epoch >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << moveLog, acked, pending, nextId >>

\* Commit any pending move (arbitrary order), appending it to the durable log.
Commit(id) ==
    /\ id \in pending
    /\ moveLog' = Append(moveLog, id)
    /\ pending' = pending \ {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED << acked, epoch, nextId >>

\* Acknowledge a move only once it appears in the durable log.
Ack(id) ==
    /\ id \in Logged
    /\ id \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED << moveLog, epoch, pending, nextId >>

Reset ==
    /\ nextId > MaxId
    /\ pending = {}
    /\ moveLog' = << >>
    /\ acked' = {}
    /\ epoch' = 0
    /\ pending' = {}
    /\ nextId' = 1

Next ==
    \/ Admit
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E id \in 1..MaxId : Commit(id)
    \/ \E id \in 1..MaxId : Ack(id)
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(* No acknowledged move is lost: every acknowledged move appears in the durable  *)
(* crane-move log.                                                               *)
NoLostUpdate == acked \subseteq Logged
====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS MaxEpoch = 2

INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A container-ship crane yard records crane moves in a durable, append-only move log
and runs epoch-numbered reconfiguration. Moves are numbered consecutively. An
admitted move first becomes pending, and pending moves may be committed in any
order — messages can be reordered. Committing a move appends it to the durable
log. A move is acknowledged back to its requester only once it appears in the
durable log, so every acknowledged move is logged and none is lost.

and becomes pending. Reconfigure: the yard advances its epoch, leaving logged and
pending moves untouched. Commit(id): any pending move, chosen in arbitrary order,
is appended to the durable move log and removed from pending. Ack(id): a move that
appears in the durable log is acknowledged to its requester. Reset: once every
move has been admitted and none is left pending, a fresh cycle resets the yard.

Because a move is acknowledged only after it has been appended to the durable

SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged crane move appears in the durable move log, so
no acknowledged move is ever lost.
